name: Select
description: Picks one option from a list shown in a popover. Use with SelectItem children.

description.description: Help text shown under the trigger.

errorMessage.description: Shown when the field is invalid.

isDisabled.description: Prevents opening and dims the field.

isInvalid.description: Marks the field as invalid and shows errorMessage.

isRequired.description: Requires a selection for form submission.

onSelectionChange.description: Called with the newly selected key.

keyboard: Enter, Space or Arrow Down opens the list
Esc closes without changing the value
requirements: Label is linked to the trigger
screenReader: On focus: the label, the current value and that it opens a list (pop-up button, collapsed)
Opening announces the list and the focused option with its position
After choosing, the new value is announced and focus is back on the field

use_when: Choosing one of roughly 5 to 15 known options
avoid_when: Few options that should be visible: use RadioGroup
Long or searchable lists: use Combobox
anti_patterns: Placeholder that looks like a real value

Passing isInvalid for required or format checks (even isInvalid={false}): any defined value takes over validity and hides the built-in errors. Use isRequired and validate; pass isInvalid only for errors the app finds itself, such as from the server
